units.source_text: 宰相君附言道：“以前屡次来书，我家小姐不解其意。

en.t: Saisho no Kimi added, "Although letters came many times before, my lady did not understand their meaning.

units.source_text: 小姐对于世间无论何事，顾虑异常周到，因此不能作复。

en.t: In all matters of the world, my lady considers things with exceptional care, and therefore she was unable to send a reply.

units.source_text: 但今后自然不会再有此种事情了。”

en.t: But from now on, such a thing will naturally not happen again."
This too was sincere feeling and sound reason.

units.source_text: 柏木答道：“如此甚好，我今日不便久留，就此告辞。

en.t: Kashiwagi replied, "That is very well. I cannot stay long today, so I shall take my leave here.

units.source_text: 今后自当尽力效劳，借以表达我之忠诚。”

en.t: From now on I will naturally do all I can to serve, and thereby show my loyalty."
Having said this, he rose and went home.

units.source_text: 此时月明如昼，天色清丽，照见柏木中将的姿态异常优雅。

en.t: At that moment the moon was bright as day and the sky was clear and beautiful, lighting up Lieutenant General Kashiwagi's figure with extraordinary elegance.

units.source_text: 他身穿常礼服，容貌昳丽，与此景色十分调和，诚可赞美。

en.t: He wore his ordinary formal robes, his features were handsome, and he harmonized perfectly with the scene, truly deserving admiration.

units.source_text: 众青年侍女相与议论：“此人容貌姿态虽然赶不上夕雾中将，但也异常优美。

en.t: The young serving women talked among themselves, saying, "Though this man's looks and bearing do not quite match Lieutenant General Yugiri's, they are still exceptionally graceful.

units.source_text: 他家兄弟姐妹怎么会个个长得如此出色呢！”

en.t: How can every one of the brothers and sisters in that family have grown up to be so outstanding!"

units.source_text: 她们每逢略有所见，照例极口称赞。

en.t: Whenever they caught even a slight glimpse of something, they praised it to the skies as usual.
